from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, lit, when, current_timestamp, to_date
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Paths & Setup
# ==============================================================================
STORAGE_ACCOUNT = "<YOUR_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME>"
RAW_PATH = f"abfss://raw@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/invoices/*/*/*.parquet"
SILVER_PATH = f"abfss://silver@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/invoices"
QUARANTINE_PATH = f"abfss://quarantine@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/invoices"
GOLD_PATH = f"abfss://gold@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/fact_invoices"

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Ingest Bronze (Target File from ADF or Wildcard fallback)
# ==============================================================================
try:
    if 'target_file_path' in locals() and target_file_path and target_file_path.strip() != "":
        print(f"Processing single delta file from ADF: {target_file_path}")
        df_bronze = spark.read.parquet(target_file_path)
    else:
        print("No parameter passed. Falling back to all raw files.")
        df_bronze = spark.read.parquet(RAW_PATH)
except Exception as e:
    print("No raw files found. Exiting.")
    mssparkutils.notebook.exit("No raw files")

# Check if empty
if df_bronze.rdd.isEmpty():
    print("Bronze dataset is empty. Exiting.")
    mssparkutils.notebook.exit("0 rows")

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Data Quality Engine (Quarantine Pattern)
# ==============================================================================
VALID_STATUSES = ['PAID', 'PENDING', 'OVERDUE', 'REFUNDED']

df_validated = df_bronze.withColumn(
    "dq_failure_reason",
    when(col("invoice_id").isNull(), "FAIL_NULL_INVOICE_ID")
    .when(col("invoice_amount") < 0, "FAIL_NEGATIVE_AMOUNT")
    .when(~col("payment_status").isin(VALID_STATUSES), "FAIL_INVALID_STATUS")
    .when(col("billing_period_end") < col("billing_period_start"), "FAIL_INVALID_DATE_RANGE")
    .otherwise("PASS")
)

df_quarantine = df_validated.filter(col("dq_failure_reason") != "PASS") \
    .withColumn("quarantined_at", current_timestamp())

df_silver_clean = df_validated.filter(col("dq_failure_reason") == "PASS") \
    .drop("dq_failure_reason") \
    .withColumn("ingested_at", current_timestamp())

# Quarantine bad rows if any exist
if not df_quarantine.rdd.isEmpty():
    df_quarantine.write.mode("append").format("delta").save(QUARANTINE_PATH)
    print(f"Quarantined {df_quarantine.count()} invalid records.")

# ==============================================================================
# 4. Silver Layer Upsert with Change Data Feed (CDF) Enabled
# ==============================================================================
if not DeltaTable.isDeltaTable(spark, SILVER_PATH):
    # Initial load: Create Silver table with Change Data Feed enabled
    df_silver_clean.write \
        .format("delta") \
        .mode("overwrite") \
        .option("delta.enableChangeDataFeed", "true") \
        .save(SILVER_PATH)
    
    silver_table = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, SILVER_PATH)
    current_version = 0
    print("Initialized Silver Delta Table with Change Data Feed (Version 0).")
else:
    silver_table = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, SILVER_PATH)
    
    # Ensure Change Data Feed property is enabled on existing table
    spark.sql(f"ALTER TABLE delta.`{SILVER_PATH}` SET TBLPROPERTIES (delta.enableChangeDataFeed = true)")
    
    # Perform Merge into Silver
    silver_table.alias("tgt").merge(
        df_silver_clean.alias("src"),
        "tgt.invoice_id = src.invoice_id"
    ).whenMatchedUpdate(set={
        "subscription_id": "src.subscription_id",
        "invoice_amount": "src.invoice_amount",
        "currency": "src.currency",
        "payment_status": "src.payment_status",
        "payment_method": "src.payment_method",
        "due_date": "src.due_date",
        "created_at": "src.created_at",
        "updated_at": "src.updated_at",
        "ingested_at": "src.ingested_at"
    }).whenNotMatchedInsertAll().execute()
    
    # Capture the exact commit version that just happened
    current_version = silver_table.history(1).select("version").collect()[0]["version"]
    print(f"Silver merge committed as Delta Version: {current_version}")

# ==============================================================================
# 5. Gold Layer: Read from Silver via Change Data Feed (CDF)
# ==============================================================================
print(f"Reading Change Data Feed from Silver table at Version {current_version}...")

# Read ONLY the changes committed in that exact version from the physical Silver table
df_silver_cdf = spark.read.format("delta") \
    .option("readChangeFeed", "true") \
    .option("startingVersion", current_version) \
    .option("endingVersion", current_version) \
    .load(SILVER_PATH)

# Delta CDF provides metadata column: `_change_type`
# Values: 'insert', 'update_preimage', 'update_postimage', 'delete'
# For analytics, we only want new inserts and the updated state ('update_postimage')
df_gold_incremental = df_silver_cdf.filter(
    col("_change_type").isin("insert", "update_postimage")
).select(
    col("invoice_id"),
    col("subscription_id"),
    col("invoice_amount").cast("double"),
    col("currency"),
    col("payment_status"),
    col("payment_method"),
    to_date(col("due_date")).alias("due_date"),
    to_date(col("billing_period_start")).alias("invoice_date"),
    when(col("payment_status") == "PAID", col("invoice_amount")).otherwise(lit(0.0)).alias("collected_amount"),
    when(col("payment_status") == "OVERDUE", col("invoice_amount")).otherwise(lit(0.0)).alias("overdue_amount")
)

# Merge into Gold Delta Table
if not DeltaTable.isDeltaTable(spark, GOLD_PATH):
    df_gold_incremental.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").save(GOLD_PATH)
    print("Initialized Gold Delta Table.")
else:
    gold_table = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, GOLD_PATH)
    gold_table.alias("tgt").merge(
        df_gold_incremental.alias("src"),
        "tgt.invoice_id = src.invoice_id"
    ).whenMatchedUpdate(set={
        "subscription_id": "src.subscription_id",
        "invoice_amount": "src.invoice_amount",
        "currency": "src.currency",
        "payment_status": "src.payment_status",
        "payment_method": "src.payment_method",
        "due_date": "src.due_date",
        "invoice_date": "src.invoice_date",
        "collected_amount": "src.collected_amount",
        "overdue_amount": "src.overdue_amount"
    }).whenNotMatchedInsertAll().execute()

print(f"Successfully processed {df_gold_incremental.count()} CDF records into Gold!")
